linkedinReason: The Nostr WoT team published a 29-slide interactive presentation in seven languages for workshops, classrooms and anyone explaining Nostr identity, events, relays, trust and signing. This shares the team's own educational resource without presenting existing protocol concepts as a new software release.
linkedin:
Nostr is easier to explain when people can move through the system one idea at a time.

Our new presentation uses 29 slides in 7 languages. It covers keys, signed events, relays, Web of Trust, remote signing, the extension and links to working guides.

It is a presentation, not a promise that every Nostr app behaves the same way.

We built it for workshops, classrooms and anyone helping new users understand what moves with their identity. Which slide clears up the first question your audience asks?

The deck explains concepts and points to resources. It does not replace hands-on key backup or client testing.
